body:
# Closing ref inventory — disposition every ref consumer and producer against the ref contract

Phase 4 of the aggregator ref-contract design (design issue #6242; design doc `files/designs/code-aggregator-ref-contract.md` in the `keep-the-four-repos-healthy` goal workspace). Gated on Phases 1–3 of #6242 (#6174 + #6195, #6210 + #6211, #6224).

The contract this phase closes out (from #6242): a ref is an annotation, not identity; validity is `isValidRef` only; an invalid ref is dropped at the consumption step beside its gate (the item survives, the drop is traced), producers mint only valid refs, and rendering/deriving reaches `refUrl` for stored/feed-derived refs only through the safe-link helper — never a throw.

## Scope

- An inventory of every `refUrl(` / `parseRef(` consumer in `pm-stack/aggregator/src` (25 `refUrl` sites at the design audit HEAD, origin/main 955ed2344) and every ref-carrying gate, scrape, derivation and store path in `pm-stack/aggregator` + `pm-stack/projector`, each dispositioned against the contract with file:line evidence: gate-dropped (rule 2) / producer-filtered (rule 3) / safe-helper (rule 4) / internal-constructed-safe (code-built refs, `parseRef` throw retained) / fixed-in-this-phase.
- The contract statement landed in `pm-stack/aggregator/src/model.ts` beside the #4952 `isValidRef` comment, so the disposition rules live where the validity rule lives.
- Required dispositions (name each explicitly on this issue, with the evidence or the follow-up issue if one is owed):
  1. `queue-view.ts:113,139` — stored refs reaching `refUrl` unguarded.
  2. `sources/live.ts:368` — the session-row `row.url ?? refUrl(row.ref, …)` fallback.
  3. `comments.ts:494` — `githubCommentUrl` against the post-#4952 store-load gates: is every stored comment's `githubRef` now guaranteed valid, or is a guard owed?
  4. `render.ts:3574` — `ensure()`'s `refUrl` fallback in the overview path (post-#6205 state), and `render.ts:6756`.
  5. `sessionRecordLine` (`render.ts:1912`) — align its omit-the-link treatment with rule 4's plain-text treatment, or record why this surface differs.
  6. A recount of stored `pmp_links` rows (projector registry) whose ref fails `isValidRef`: how many exist, and confirmation that Phase 2's consumption filtering disarms them (no hand-deletion required for safety).
  7. Any raw `matchAll` ref scrape outside `titleRefs` / `refsInText` (rule 3) — the #6205 fix's second vector (a title re-scrape beside `refsInText`) is the shape to grep for.
- Probe evidence: for each surface this phase changes, a bad-ref case (unsafe-integer and non-GitHub forms) rendering/deriving without a throw, with a valid-ref control unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The inventory is posted on this issue (or in the model.ts contract statement it lands) with a disposition per site and no site left unclassified.
- [ ] The contract statement is on main in `model.ts` beside the #4952 comment.
- [ ] All seven required dispositions are recorded with evidence or a linked follow-up issue.
- [ ] Any site fixed in this phase carries pinning tests in the aggregator suite; the `bun test` aggregator suite passes (via CI per fleet policy).
- [ ] The design issue #6242 is commented with the closing state so its acceptance can be checked off.
